product_wide_rationale: The design record belongs to the implementation change and must travel as durable state, while lane methodology remains host-owned under CD-0043 D1.
summary: Architecture-capable pins require a coordinator-authored design, ordered edit/integration slices, and a validated joint packet-capacity allocation. Contract recording binds the design under its existing consent policy, including engineering without a consequence_v1 prompt. revise_design is routine, preserves the envelope and accepted prefix, and never resets retries. Typed packets carry one recorded architecture. Historical pins retain their meaning.
title: The design record travels with the implement packet
